title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS)

criteria.text: Epilepsy: medically refractory partial onset seizures and surgery not recommended or failed
criteria.span: VNS is reasonable and necessary for patients with medically refractory partial onset seizures for whom surgery is not recommended or for whom surgery has failed

criteria.text: All other seizure types are non-covered
criteria.span: VNS is not reasonable and necessary for all other types of seizure disorders which are medically refractory and for whom surgery is not recommended or for whom surgery has failed

criteria.text: TRD covered only within a CMS-approved CED study
criteria.span: VNS is non-covered for the treatment of TRD when furnished outside of a CMS-approved CED study.

criteria.text: TRD: current MDD episode >= 2 years or >= 4 MDD episodes including current
criteria.span: The patient must be in a major depressive disorder (MDD) episode for ≥ two years or have had at least four episodes of MDD, including the current episode.

criteria.text: TRD: at least four prior failed treatments of adequate dose and duration, measured by a tool
criteria.span: The patient’s depressive illness meets a minimum criterion of four prior failed treatments of adequate dose and duration as measured by a tool designed for this purpose.

criteria.text: TRD: MDE measured by a guideline-recommended scale on two visits within 45 days before implant
criteria.span: The patient is experiencing a major depressive episode (MDE) as measured by a guideline recommended depression scale assessment tool on two visits, within a 45-day span prior to implantation of the VNS device.

criteria.text: TRD: stable medication regimen for at least four weeks before implant
criteria.span: Patients must maintain a stable medication regimen for at least four weeks before device implantation.

criteria.text: TRD exclusion: current or lifetime psychotic features in any MDE
criteria.span: Current or lifetime history of psychotic features in any MDE

criteria.text: Replacement for TRD patients at battery end of life or device malfunction
criteria.span: Patients implanted with a VNS device for TRD may receive a VNS device replacement if it is required due to the end of battery life, or any other device-related malfunction.

notes: Epilepsy coverage is national (no CED). TRD coverage only inside a CMS-approved CED trial. Ambiguity for expert review: Section D (replacement for TRD patients) does not say whether the replacement must also be furnished within the CED study; the replacement case is built so the patient is still enrolled in the CMS-approved extension study, so it is covered under either reading.
